verdict.rationale: Dover documents basic interview scheduling: candidate booking links, manual Schedule Interview, direct calendar booking with Full permissions, and per-stage interviewers. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic scheduling of multi-interviewer panels or full onsite loops, and there is no interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution. Single-interview scheduling is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
